description: Western Carriers (India) Limited provides logistics and allied services in India. The company provides single window logistics, multi-modal transportation, rail, road, cargo handling, custom house agency, and ocean and air freight services, as well as labelling, product packaging, customs clearance, stevedoring, palletizing, fumigation, pre-shipment inspection, and containerization services. It also operates warehouse/redistribution centers. Western Carriers (India) Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Kolkata, India.
